hookups.source: Bartow County WebTrac rental detail for USC 001-018 ('Standard Electric Site: Accommodates 30 & 50 Amp', 'Water Hookups', 'Dump Station on Site, No Sewer hookups'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 18 water/electric RV sites, back-in except site 16 (pull-through, 20 ft); driveways 19-33 ft, and 11 of the 18 take 23 ft or more (sites 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 12, 13, 15, 17, 18). Sites 19-20 are tent-only, water only, up a steep road posted no RVs or trailers.

sites.source: Bartow County WebTrac rental detail ('Equipment length/Driveway: 25' Back-In' etc. per site; 'USC 016 (20') WF Pull-Through'; 'USC 019 Tent Only', 'USC 020 Tent Only') + county campground map ('Steep road No RVs or trailers' to sites 19-20; legend water only / water and power), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: Bartow County WebTrac rental detail ('Dump Station on Site') + county campground map ('Rest Room and Shower', 'Dump Station'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $30 a night at the non-waterfront RV sites, $34 at the waterfront (WF) sites 7-16; tent-only sites $24. No resident/non-resident rate shown. $10 fee on any cancellation.

fees.source: Bartow County WebTrac rental search for 06/15/2027 (USC 001-006 and 017-018 '$30.00', USC 007-016 'WF' '$34.00', USC 019-020 'Tent Only' '$24.00') + Campground Rules rev. 2024-06-19 ('ALL CANCELLATIONS WILL INCUR A $10.00 CANCELLATION FEE'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Bartow County's WebTrac reservation site or the campground office, 770-607-6245 (Mon-Fri 8-5, Sat 8-4). Golden Age / Access pass holders call the office to add the pass before booking. 14 nights in any 30 days, then away 16 days. No check-in after 9:30 pm; gate closed 10:30 pm - 7 am.

booking.source: https://www.bartowcountyga.gov/departments/parksandrecreation/parks_and_facilities.php ('Campground Rentals: 770-607-6245'; 'We now require a 2 night minimum stay at all campgrounds on Friday and Saturday nights'; pass-holder line) + Campground Rules rev. 2024-06-19 ('CAMPING LIMIT is a maximum of 14 consecutive days or 14 non-consecutive days in any 30-day period ... leave the campground for 16 days'; gate hours), read 2026-10-29

note: Bartow County Parks & Recreation campground on USACE Allatoona Lake (Etowah River arm), formerly a Corps concession. The waterfront sites are 7-16, along the peninsula toward the swim beach and boat ramp. --Claude
summary: Bartow County WebTrac (still the engine; the county's Rec1 catalog has no campground items) + county parks page, rules PDF and site map: 18 water/50-amp RV sites (19-33 ft, 11 take 23 ft+, site 16 pull-through) + 2 tent-only, no sewer, dump + shower house; $30 / $34 waterfront (June 2027), weekend 2-night minimum, 14-night max. Season not stated by the county (left as is). Lakefront supported: the county map shows the loop on a peninsula with sites 7-16 marked WF on the shore.
